intro.h2: Home remodeling in Towson, done on time and with respect
paragraphs: Flores J construction LLC is a building firm based at 8206 Loch Raven Blvd in Towson, MD. We take on home remodeling work, and our Google photos show the range: a basement with a smooth new ceiling, recessed lights and fresh crown molding, and a raised deck with its stairs finished in a warm cedar tone.

Our first Google review sums up what we aim for on every job. After we did remodeling work at her home, Esmeralda said she was very happy and called our team professionals who are punctual and respectful. We read our reviews and answer them ourselves, and our phone line is listed as open around the clock.

services.h2: Remodeling work we take on in Towson

items.name: Home remodeling
items.blurb: Remodeling is the work our first Google review describes, and that customer was very happy with the result. Tell us which rooms you want to change and what bothers you about them now, and we will talk through the work, the order it happens in and the price.

items.name: Basement ceilings and lighting
items.blurb: In one basement we put up a smooth new ceiling with white soffits, added rows of recessed lights and ran white crown molding along the knotty pine walls. A dark lower level turned into a bright, usable room. Ask us about your basement.

image.alt: Basement with a new smooth white ceiling, white soffits, recessed lights and crown molding above knotty pine paneled walls

items.name: Decks and outdoor stairs
items.blurb: Outdoor work is part of what we do too. The raised deck shown here, with its railings, posts and long staircase down to the yard, is finished in a warm cedar tone from top to bottom. Call us about your deck, porch stairs or railings.

image.alt: Raised wooden deck with railings and a long staircase to the lawn, finished in a warm cedar tone, behind a beige sided house

items.title: We show up on time
items.text: Our first reviewer calls us punctual. Arriving when we say we will is the simplest way we know to respect your time while your home is being worked on.

items.title: Respect for your home
items.text: The same customer calls our team respectful. We are working in the place where you live, and we treat the house, and you, that way from the first visit to the last.

items.title: A local Towson address
items.text: We work from 8206 Loch Raven Blvd in Towson, so we are close by when you want to meet, look over progress or plan the next project.

items.title: Inside and outside the house
items.text: Our photos show both kinds of work: a basement ceiling with recessed lighting and crown molding, and a raised deck with a full staircase finished in a cedar tone.

about.text: Flores J construction LLC is a building firm at 8206 Loch Raven Blvd in Towson, Maryland. We handle remodeling work for homeowners, indoors and out. Google lists 60 photos of our work, and the two shown on this page give a sense of the range: a finished basement ceiling with recessed lights, and a raised deck with its own staircase. Our first customer review describes a crew that is professional, punctual and respectful, and when it was posted we wrote back to thank her for trusting our team. Call us any time to talk about your project.

image.alt: Basement project with a new white ceiling and recessed lights, with a broom and tools still leaning on the knotty pine wall

process.h2: How a project with us works

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Call (443) 273-4012 and tell us what you want remodeled, repaired or built. Our line is listed as open 24 hours.

steps.title: We look at the space
steps.text: We come out to see the rooms, basement or deck, take measurements and listen to what you want to change.

steps.title: Agree on the plan and price
steps.text: You get the scope of the work and a price before we start, so you know what will happen and in what order.

steps.title: The work gets done
steps.text: Our crew arrives on time and treats your home with respect, the two things our first customer noticed most.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: We walk through the finished work with you, so you can look over every detail before we wrap up the job.

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: We are a building firm doing home remodeling in Towson, MD. Our photos on Google show a basement with a new ceiling, recessed lights and crown molding, and a raised deck with stairs finished in a cedar tone. Call us to describe your project and we will tell you whether it fits.

Our address is 8206 Loch Raven Blvd, Towson, MD 21286. If you are not sure whether we can work at your home, call (443) 273-4012 and tell us your neighborhood or town, along with a quick description of the project you have in mind.

Google lists our hours as open 24 hours, seven days a week, so you can call (443) 273-4012 whenever it suits you. You can also email floresjconstructionllc@gmail.com with photos of the space and a short note about what you want done.

Yes. One of our projects shows a basement with a smooth new ceiling, white soffits, rows of recessed lights and crown molding along the wood-paneled walls. If your lower level feels dark or unfinished, call us to talk about what could change and what it would take.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call (443) 273-4012 or send an email with a few photos and a short description of the job. We will ask about the space and what you want done, come take a look, and give you a price before any work starts.
